source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_incident_request_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_9') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_9_OLEDBSource_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_incident_request_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_9') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_9_OLEDBSource_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_incident_request_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_9') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_9_OLEDBSource_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_incident_request_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_9') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_9_OLEDBDestination_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_incident_request_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_9') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_9_OLEDBDestination_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_incident_request_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'data_flow_task_1_9') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_9_OLEDBDestination_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Data_Flow_Task_1_90_sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_incident_request_data_import') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_90_sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Data_Flow_Task_1_90_sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_incident_request_data_import') AS Data_Flow_Task_1_90_sink_TableName;
